get.summary: The store's Google rating and recent Google reviews
get.description: Read live from the Places API (New) on every request, because Google's terms allow storing a place's ID and nothing else of it; the answer carries Cache-Control: no-store. rating and user_rating_count are Google's own figures. reviews are the at most five Google sends, in its order (most relevant first), none left out; text is the reviewer's own words in their language, never Google's translation. Each review carries what Google's attribution policy asks a storefront to show: the author's name, profile link and photo, a link to the review on Google Maps and one to report it. Every link is https or absent. 404 while the plugin or its show_place switch is off, or the key or place ID is unset; 429 once the store's daily_lookups are used up for the day (UTC); 502 when Google refuses or fails, the reason logged on the server.

rating.description: 1.0 to 5.0; 0 when Google has no rating.

relative_time.description: Google's own words for when, such as "a month ago".

502.description: `google_unavailable`: Google refused the key or did not answer.

get.summary: What Google Customer Reviews' survey opt-in is rendered with, for one order
get.description: For the order confirmation page of the shopper holding the order's access token (the same token GET /api/orders/{number} takes). Every field comes from the order: merchant_id is the store's Merchant Center ID, order_id the order number, email the order's, delivery_country its shipping address's ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country, and estimated_delivery_date (YYYY-MM-DD) the day it was placed (UTC) plus the store's delivery_days. opt_in_style is Google's name for where the offer appears, absent for Google's default. Cache-Control: no-store. 404 while the plugin or its customer_reviews switch is off, without a numeric merchant ID or a delivery estimate, for a wrong or missing token, for an order that is awaiting payment or cancelled, and for an order with no usable email or country: Google requires each, so a missing one means no survey rather than a guess.

get.summary: The store's product reviews as a Google product reviews feed, for Merchant Center's Product Ratings
get.description: Google's product reviews feed, schema 2.4. Every published, verified review of a product the store still has, on sale or not, every rating, oldest first, because Google deletes a review that leaves the feed; a review whose words hold an email address, a phone number or a link is left out, as Google's Product Ratings policies ask, and the sample shop's reviews are never in it. Each review carries review_id, the reviewer as a first name and an initial (Anonymous, with is_anonymous, when the name is itself contact details), review_timestamp, title when there is one, content, review_url (the product's page, type group), ratings/overall on 1 to 5, one product per variant the product feed lists (every variant, for a product it does not) with the product feed's own gtin, mpn, sku, brand, name and link, so Merchant Center matches them, and is_verified_purchase, in the XSD's order. Generated on request; cacheable for fifteen minutes. 404 while the plugin or its product_ratings switch is off; 409 while the reviews or feeds module is missing, product reviews are off, or the product feed is off or has no storefront URL.
